name: Full account handbook (large)
angle: A reader who wants the whole account topic on one page.
intent_summary: Complete brand-subpage for the large size group of the competitors, built like the longest login page of the query: a handbook of the Longfu88 account for players from Malaysia with access (login, lost password, failed logins), entry (registration and the welcome offer), compliance (verification documents and procedure), protection (credentials and data), settings and communication, currencies and the one-account rule, taking a break or closing the account, what opens after the login, mobile access, the VIP programme, support and a FAQ. Page voice: reference-like, each H2 opens with what the section is for, sentences of about 18 words, a consequence after each condition; one plain invitation to register. Every extra section is written only from the facts of its Brand Information; where a section has few facts it stays short. H2 sections with H3 details. All brand facts come from the AffBulk knowledge base longfu88-new; nothing is claimed about the legal status of the casino in Malaysia.

blocks.heading: Longfu88 Account Handbook for Malaysian Players
edit: (login, password reset, registration, verification, security, support)
(access, entry, compliance, protection, settings, taking a break, mobile access, the VIP programme, support)

blocks.heading: Entry: Opening an Account
blocks.extra: One plain invitation to register is allowed here.

blocks.heading: Protection: Credentials and Data
blocks.extra: Add with whom data may be shared and which rights the player has, as short lists inside the paragraph.

blocks.heading: Compliance: Verification Documents
blocks.extra: After the table give the procedure in one sentence (upload legible, current documents that match the account profile; telephone or face verification if requested; wait for approval before a withdrawal).

blocks.heading: Settings: Communication Preferences and Cookies
blocks.summary: Which settings the player controls: promotional communication and the cookies of the site.
connections: direct-marketing preferences and can unsubscribe from promotional communications
blocks.notes: Two facts only, exactly as in the Brand Information: the player may manage direct-marketing preferences and unsubscribe from promotional communications; necessary, preference, analytics and marketing cookies support website functions and measurement. Do not invent account settings, screens, limits (deposit, loss, session) or profile fields and do not say where in the account to find these settings. Neutral tone.

blocks.heading: Currencies and the One-Account Rule
blocks.summary: Which currencies an account can use and the rules for the account itself: accurate details, one personal account, no third-party payment methods.
connections: one personal account in one of the supported currencies
blocks.notes: State the currencies exactly as listed (EUR, USD, MYR, THB, SGD and USDT) and do not convert amounts or mention exchange rates, conversion or a choice of currency at registration: none is given. The player requirements: register with accurate information, use only one personal account, do not use third-party payment methods. Calm tone, no legal advice. Do not say or imply that the casino is licensed, legal or approved in Malaysia.

blocks.heading: Taking a Break or Closing the Account
blocks.summary: How a player limits or ends access: self-exclusion, account closure through support, self-assessment questions and independent help organisations.
connections: self-exclusion or account closure through customer support
blocks.notes: Players must be at least 18 and gamble only where lawful. A player who wants to stop contacts support and asks for self-exclusion or account closure; account access and gambling may then be restricted for the agreed period. Self-assessment questions help to recognise possible harm. Independent support: GamCare, Gamblers Anonymous and Gambling Therapy. Do not print the e-mail address of the self-exclusion request (it contains the brand name) and do not state a processing time. Accurate and practical, not moralising.

blocks.heading: What Opens After the Login
blocks.summary: What a player reaches after logging in: the casino games, the sportsbook, the cashier and the bonuses.
connections: the casino, the sportsbook, deposits, withdrawals and bonuses
blocks.notes: One lead-in sentence that names what the account gives access to (casino, sportsbook, account access, deposits, withdrawals, bonuses), then a bulleted list of the game categories exactly as in the Brand Information (slots, live dealer games, table games, jackpots, fishing, P2P games, fast games, lottery, crash and instant games). No game names, providers or RTP values. Keep it short: this is a pointer to the rest of the site.

blocks.heading: Mobile and Tablet Access
blocks.summary: Logging in from a phone or a tablet in the browser and adding a home-screen shortcut on Android (Chrome) and iOS (Safari).
connections: a shortcut of the website to the home screen
blocks.notes: The casino works in the browser of a smartphone or a tablet; the Brand Information has no download from an app store: do not call it a downloadable app and do not mention APK files or app stores. A short paragraph, then a bulleted list with two items: Android (open the site in Chrome, open the browser menu and choose Add to Home screen, confirm the shortcut) and iOS (open the site in Safari, tap Share and choose Add to Home Screen, confirm Add). The login on a phone is the same as on a computer. Write "the site" in the steps instead of the brand name.

blocks.heading: VIP Levels and Rewards
blocks.summary: What a logged-in player gets from the VIP programme: five tiers, points from real-money play, the extra benefits and the terms.
connections: VIP points through eligible real-money gameplay, which unlock reward levels
blocks.notes: Five tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. Points are earned through eligible real-money gameplay and unlock numbered reward levels. Additional benefits: personalised offers, VIP cashback, higher withdrawal limits and a personal VIP manager for eligible high tiers. Terms: reward and withdrawal limits may differ by VIP level and currency, and level-based benefits and eligibility may change under the programme rules. Do not give level numbers, point thresholds, rewards or limits (they are on the VIP page) and do not use the official name of the programme (it contains the brand name).

blocks.heading: Handbook FAQ
blocks.summary: 8 short questions and answers on the login and the account.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 8 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) how to log in (with the registered e-mail and password, as the page explains); (2) what to do after a forgotten password (request a reset link with the registered e-mail); (3) which login method the casino uses (e-mail and password); (4) which details registration asks for (e-mail, password, legal name, date of birth, residential address); (5) which identity document is accepted (passport, national identity card or driving licence); (6) how long verification takes (a complete document set is normally reviewed within up to 10 days); (7) whether a player may hold more than one account (no: one personal account per player); (8) whether there is a VIP programme (yes, with five tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not answer questions about multiple devices, lockouts or login limits: no data.
